method: Clean public base matches 72 of 75 recorded source hashes. Replace exactly three source blobs with the already-public Hosted copies. The base VERSION matches the original provenance hash; Hosted VERSION remains release-owned. Verify all 75 normalized file hashes, including the unchanged binary font, before publishing the new source checkpoint.
limits: This is a new reconstruction from existing source bytes, not recovery or authentication of the historical commit, its date or authorship.
The unavailable historical commit is absent from both preserved and clean Git object stores and has no certified privacy-rewrite mapping.
No Hosted runtime, policy, dependency, version, deployment or canonical-core migration is changed.
The reconstructed checkpoint remains retained for exact-SHA fetch through the non-release archive ref and must not be integrated into main as a feature or release.
